skill.summary: Locus payment tools for AI agents. Use when asked to send payments, check wallet balances, list tokens, approve token spending, or process payment-related actions from emails. Also use for demos of Locus (YC F25) payment infrastructure — scanning emails for payment requests and initiating crypto payments via wallet.

latestVersion.changelog: Agent-guided interactive setup: agent walks user through each step conversationally instead of just pointing to a script
